description: Token Balances (Batch). Calls only POST /v4/wallets/batch/token-balances. The request body lists wallets to read. This tool does not create, modify, or delete data. Solana API endpoint for fetching multi-wallet token balances with SPL and Token-2022 assets, USD values, staking data, and aggregated portfolio metrics.

body.description: Response payload model for account params tokens many results returned by this API endpoint.

includeNoPriceBalance.description: Whether or not we should include tokens we do not track prices for.

limit.description: The limit of entries to return (per wallet). If not passed, first 1000 entries are returned (the maximum).

maxAssetValue.description: The maximum amount of total value in USD for an asset to be considered in the results. Overrides `includeNoPriceBalance` Defaults to no limit.

minAssetValue.description: The minimum amount of total value in USD for an asset to be considered in the results. Overrides `includeNoPriceBalance` Defaults to no limit.

mintAddresses.description: The allowable mint addresses, if any, to filter the results by.

onlyVerified.description: Whether tokens returned should be restricted to verified tokens only. Default is false.

ownerAddresses.description: Wallets to include in the returned results (max 10, with 10,000 maximum token accounts between them).

sortByAsc.description: Sort ascending based on amount or value of positions. Only one of `sortByAsc` or `sortByDesc` can be used

sortByDesc.description: Sort descending based on amount or value of positions. Only one of `sortByAsc` or `sortByDesc` can be used

vybeTokenFilter.description: Whether Vybe's token filter should restrict the tokens that are returned. Default is true.

name: get-token-balances-batch
title: Token Balances (Batch)
